sourceTables.query: select *, id as p_id, msftModifiedDatetime as p_msftModifiedDatetime, cast(parse_extension(address[0].extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation,latitude', 'valueDecimal', '') as float) as p_latitude, cast(parse_extension(address[0].extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation,longitude', 'valueDecimal', '') as float) as p_longitude, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code,system') as p_race_standard, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code') as p_race_code, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'display') as p_race_display_value,parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code,system') as p_ethnicity_standard, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code') as p_ethnicity_code,parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'display') as p_ethnicity_display_value from Patient

sourceFields.fieldCalculatedValue: concat_ws('', address[0].country, address[0].city, address[0].postalCode, address[0].line[0], address[0].line[1])

sourceTables.query: select *, id as e_id, CASE WHEN hospitalization.reAdmission.text = 'Re-admission' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END as readmission, msftModifiedDatetime as e_msftModifiedDatetime, case when array_contains(participant.individual.type, 'Practitioner') then participant[array_position(participant.individual.type, 'Practitioner')-1].individual.id else NULL end as e_participant_individual_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, period.start, period.end) as length_of_stay_minutes from Encounter
select *, id as p_id, msftModifiedDatetime as p_msftModifiedDatetime from Procedure

select eob.id,CASE WHEN eob.patient.id IS NULL THEN patient.id ELSE eob.patient.id END AS p_id,total[0].amount.value as total_charge_amt, billablePeriod, msftModifiedDatetime as is_msftModifiedDatetime FROM ExplanationOfBenefit eob LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.id, p.value, e.id as e_id FROM (SELECT pa.id, i.value FROM Patient pa LATERAL VIEW explode(identifier) AS i WHERE i.type.text = 'Medicare Beneficiary Identifier') p INNER JOIN (SELECT ide.value, exob.id FROM ExplanationOfBenefit exob LATERAL VIEW explode(identifier) AS ide WHERE ide.type.coding[0].display = 'Medicare Beneficiary Identifier') e ON p.value = e.value) patient ON eob.id = patient.e_id

SELECT o.*, o.id AS o_id, p.id AS p_id, e.id AS encounter_id FROM Observation o LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding.code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding.code) p ON p.value = o.subject.identifier.value AND (p.system = o.subject.identifier.system OR (p.system IS NULL AND o.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (p.type_code = o.subject.identifier.type.coding.code OR (p.type_code IS NULL AND o.subject.identifier.type.coding.code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(enc.id) AS id, enc_i.value AS value, enc_i.system AS system, enc_i.type.coding.code AS type_code FROM Encounter enc LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS enc_i GROUP BY enc_i.value, enc_i.system, enc_i.type.coding.code) e ON e.value = o.encounter.identifier.value AND (e.system = o.encounter.identifier.system OR (e.system IS NULL AND o.encounter.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (e.type_code = o.encounter.identifier.type.coding.code OR (e.type_code IS NULL AND o.encounter.identifier.type.coding.code IS NULL))

SELECT cp.subject.type AS subject_type, cp.subject.id AS subject_id, cp.status AS status, cp.category AS category, cp.title AS title, cp.description AS description, cp.period AS period, cp.id AS id, cp.msftModifiedDatetime AS msftModifiedDatetime FROM CarePlan cp

SELECT cp.subject.type as subject_type, cp.subject.id as subject_id, cp.id as id, cp.msftModifiedDatetime as msftModifiedDatetime, ad.kind as activity_kind, ad.status as activity_status, ad.code.coding.code[0] as activity_type, ad.code.text as activity_type_text, ad.dailyAmount.value as dailyAmount, ad.quantity.value as quantity FROM CarePlan cp LATERAL VIEW explode(cp.activity.detail) exploded_activity AS ad

SELECT cp.id as care_plan_id, conditions.id as id, conditions.idOrig as idOrig, cp.msftModifiedDatetime as msftModifiedDatetime FROM CarePlan cp LATERAL VIEW explode(cp.addresses) exploded_addresses AS conditions
SELECT cp.id as care_plan_id, goals.id as id, goals.idOrig as idOrig, cp.msftModifiedDatetime as msftModifiedDatetime FROM CarePlan cp LATERAL VIEW explode(cp.goal) exploded_goal AS goals
SELECT *, CASE WHEN SocialDeterminantValue RLIKE '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(SocialDeterminantValue AS DECIMAL(18,8)) ELSE NULL END AS formatted_value FROM SocialDeterminant
select UnitOfMeasureId, UnitOfMeasureName,UnitOfMeasureDescription, UnitOfMeasureAbbreviation, SourceModifiedOn from UnitOfMeasure

SELECT sc.SourceModifiedOn as SourceModifiedOn,sc.SocialDeterminantSubCategoryId, sc.SocialDeterminantSubCategoryName, sc.SocialDeterminantSubCategoryDescription, sc.SocialDeterminantCategoryId, c.SocialDeterminantCategoryName, c.SocialDeterminantCategoryDescription FROM SocialDeterminantSubCategory sc JOIN SocialDeterminantCategory c ON sc.SocialDeterminantCategoryId = c.SocialDeterminantCategoryId
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS SourceModifiedOn FROM ZipToFipsMapping

select distinct address[0].postalCode as zip, address[0].state as state, address[0].city as city, address[0].country as country, msftModifiedDatetime from Patient where address[0].postalCode is not null
SELECT DISTINCT locationValue, locationType, SourceModifiedOn FROM SocialDeterminant WHERE locationValue is not null and lower(locationType) LIKE '%fips%'
